headline: BREAKING: Duane “Keefe D” Davis has been found guilty in connection with the 1996 case inv
body:
BREAKING: Duane “Keefe D” Davis has been found guilty in connection with the 1996 case involving Tupac Shakur.

The verdict arrives nearly 30 years after Tupac’s passing and marks the first conviction connected to the case. Davis now faces the possibility of life in prison, with sentencing still to come.
